items.text: In 2024, GreenLeaf Co. made meaningful progress toward a more sustainable future. We eliminated 500 tonnes of packaging waste, significantly reducing our environmental footprint across the product lifecycle. Since March, our shipping operations have been fully carbon neutral, reflecting our commitment to cleaner logistics at scale. We also expanded our supplier ethics program to cover 200 of our 340 suppliers, embedding responsible sourcing deeper into our supply chain. These milestones demonstrate that sustainability is not a peripheral concern but a core driver of how GreenLeaf operates — and a foundation for the progress still to come.
items.notes: Source label: GreenLeaf executive summary, approximately 95 words.
